messages:
Riley (PM): Quick sync: GA checklist we promised execs needs closure today. Key items: SLA formula, pricing SKUs (burst vs sustained), tagging for cost attribution, docs + troubleshooting, and incident runbook. Who's owning what?
Noah (Product Finance): I'll own pricing SKUs and the burst/vs-sustained definitions. Need input from Eng on typical sustained tps and peak multipliers.
Vik (Eng): We can provide typicals. For inference gen workloads we see sustained ~12 rps per model per GPU on avg; peaks 3-5x during spikes. Will add a short table.
Dana (Legal): SLA reparations: we need a precise credit calculation and an exclusions list (maintenance, customer misconfig, force majeure). Also need to scrub 'automatic refunds' language.
Riley (PM): Proposal: SLA credit = min(30% of monthly invoice * (downtime_pct / SLA_target_pct), $50k). Drafted that as a placeholder. Legal?
Dana (Legal): Placeholder ok for product discussion, but Legal will push for capped liability, explicit measurement windows, and a clearly defined verification flow. I'll send redlines tonight.
Lina (SRE): Monitoring: add these synthetic checks - 1) end-to-end generate p95, 2) model-specific latency SLO by region, 3) KV-cache hit rate alert. We'll need runbook links.
Omar (Support): Support readiness: triage matrix + escalation path needed. Two common asks from pilots: (a) how to request a temporary capacity burst, (b) how to dispute a billing spike. Docs should cover both.
Priya (Docs): I'll draft a Billing FAQ + Troubleshooting quickstart. Can someone give me the exact billing tag names we plan to use?
BillingBot: New promo code template created: PROMO-GA-2026 (expires 2026-06-30). Requires SKU mapping.
Noah (Product Finance): SKU names: redwood.hosted.generate.standard, redwood.hosted.generate.burst. Promo maps to hosted.generate.standard. Can we confirm?
Vik (Eng): Confirm tags: customer:billing_bucket=hosted_standard | hosted_burst. Also add tag: internal:dedicated_pool for Dedicated routing.
Priya (Docs): Thanks — I'll use those exact keys.
Lina (SRE): A note on noise: KV-cache alerts are noisy on warmup. We propose graduating severity: first 10m = info, 10-60m = warning, >60m = P1. Any objections?
Dana (Legal): Sounds operationally reasonable. Legal wants the SLA measurement window to discount transient issues under 5 minutes per incident.
Riley (PM): Agree. Add an incident de-dup rule: contiguous degradations <5m are merged.
Omar (Support): For customer comms: template for outage notification + credits flow. Who writes the template?
Riley (PM): I'll draft the customer notification; Omar please prep the support playbook.
Noah (Product Finance): Two commercial asks: 1) Pilot customers need an opt-in for promo SKUs (so billing doesn't auto-apply), 2) define how committed usage converts to reserved capacity credits. Need Product + Eng input.
Vik (Eng): Reserved capacity credits: mapping is 1 committed GPU hour -> X inference units (we'll provide conversion table). Also need to define throttling behavior when reserved pool exhausted (fallback to hosted with higher per-token rate or deny).
Riley (PM): Decision required: fallback policy for Dedicated overloads. Options: A) soft-fallback to hosted (auto-bill at burst SKU), B) reject requests with clear error + guidance. Thoughts?
Noah (Product Finance): From a revenue POV, A reduces downtime for customers but could complicate billing. If we do A, need explicit consent in SLA and a billing flag.
Dana (Legal): Legally prefer B by default (fails closed), with A allowed if customer signs opt-in addendum. Minimizes surprises.
Omar (Support): Customers will prefer A. But if A is opt-in, support can guide them through on-boarding.
Riley (PM): Let's go with Dana's recommendation: default = reject with 429 + error body. Opt-in addendum enables soft-fallback; capture consent in account settings. Action: Dana to draft addendum; Noah to design opt-in flag.
Dana (Legal): Will draft addendum and sample consent text.
Noah (Product Finance): I'll add opt-in boolean to billing API and update pricing docs.
Priya (Docs): For the SDK quickstart we also need an example of error handling for 429 and fallback guidance. Vik, can you paste a short snippet?
Vik (Eng): Short snippet incoming:
```
# pseudo-code
resp = client.generate(...)
if resp.status == 429:
  # if customer opted-in, client should retry against hosted endpoint
  # otherwise surface error with link to upgrade/reserve
```
Priya (Docs): Perfect. I'll include that and an example billing dispute flow.
Lina (SRE): Final operational ask: add a dashboard tile for GA showing: active reservations, pool utilization %, avg latency P95, KV-cache hit %. Priya: want a screenshot in docs?
Priya (Docs): Yes — a mock screenshot is fine for GA docs.
Riley (PM): OK owners recap: SLA language + addendum = Dana (Legal) + Riley (PM) review; Pricing SKUs + promo = Noah; Billing opt-in flag = Noah + Billing team; Fallback opt-in addendum = Dana; Runbooks + dashboard = Lina; Support templates = Omar; Docs merge = Priya. Target: close all by EOD today for release tomorrow.
BillingBot: Promo PROMO-GA-2026 linked to SKU hosted.generate.standard (requires manual enable).
Noah (Product Finance): I'll push final SKU table and cost examples in 1hr.
Vik (Eng): I'll attach conversion table for reserved credits and the small SDK snippet before EOD.
Dana (Legal): Sending initial redlines in ~3h.
Priya (Docs): I'll open docs PR when snippets + redlines are in; want final signoff from Legal before merge.
Riley (PM): Thanks all. If any blockers pop up, post here. We'll run a last acceptance smoke tomorrow with billing + support on the call. :white_check_mark:
